description: Read-only Page Builder capability probe for a caller-supplied Magento project root. Version-aware: reads composer.lock for platform/module versions, app/etc/config.php (narrow PHP-array reader) for enablement, per-file content-type declarations under view/adminhtml/pagebuilder/content_type/ (the legacy single etc/content_type.xml does NOT exist in current versions), per-module etc/widget.xml and di.xml component registries. Deny-listed surfaces (env.php, auth.json, .git, var/, pub/, generated/, node_modules/) are never read; out-of-scope candidates are skipped with LOCATOR_OUT_OF_SCOPE. Proof ceiling: REGISTERED (config-declaration evidence only) — never runtime/admin claims.
